subQuests.subQuestName: Accompany Ganyu to return to Liyue Harbor

110310103.text: Come on, Ganyu, we're almost there. You don't want to turn back now, do you?

110310104.text: I suppose you have a point. It would be quite impolite of me to leave the two of you now.

110310105.text: That's right! Where do you wanna go first then?

110310106.text: I've spent too much time in the mountains. The first thing that comes to my mind is the sea.

110310107.text: Let's go for a walk in the port.

110310301.text: Ms. Ganyu! It's been too long!

110310302.text: I don't know why, but seeing you brings me a sense of peace in these chaotic times.

110310303.text: Indeed, it has been a while, Huixin. I'm flattered, but aren't you exaggerating a little?

110310304.text: I heard that you've encountered some problems, and came to see if I could be of some help.

110310305.text: *sigh* My father asked you to come, didn't he?

110310306.text: Abusing his status as a member of the Qixing to trouble you...

110310307.text: Hehe, don't worry. I'm always happy to help a junior colleague from Yuehai Pavilion.

110310308.text: Ganyu's not only a competent secretary but also a great mentor.

110310309.text: So, what can you tell me about the problem?

110310310.text: Uh, where should I start? I discovered something strange while organizing tax records...

110310311.text: There are obvious irregularities in the tax declarations of two stores: Second Life and Wanyou Boutique. However, whether I question the shopkeepers or check their accounts, I... I can't seem to make any progress with my investigation.

110310312.text: Without any evidence, my hands are tied.

110310313.text: I see. It's not uncommon for merchants to be blinded by greed.

110310314.text: Well, is there any solution you can advise?

110310315.text: Naturally. I've dealt with similar issues hundreds of times. Give me a moment to consider the best approach in this scenario...

110310316.text: That's a thousand years of work experience for you...

110310317.text: Alright... Let's approach it this way, then: "Your enemy knows you best."

110310319.text: If I remember correctly, Second Life and Wanyou Boutique are old business rivals, competing for market share due to their similar wares.

110310321.text: In that case... Ah, I know what you mean, Ms. Ganyu!

110310323.text: Ms. Ganyu plans to let them expose each other.

110310326.text: Let's start with Wanyou Boutique. The owner's name is... Bolai, isn't it?

110310327.text: Yes, you're right. Follow me, please!

110310201.text: The sound of the waves in this familiar port...

110310202.text: The smell of the sea breeze makes me nostalgic.

110310203.text: Ganyu, you didn't leave Liyue for that long. Why do you look so moved?

110310204.text: Well, I used to be so busy. I haven't taken a stroll around here in a long time.

110310205.text: Huh... That's true, Ganyu seemed to be working all the time.

110310206.text: Well, when I think about my time here, I've spent most of it behind a desk, filing documents.

110310207.text: It put me in a certain mood — similar to the one I felt during my training in Jueyun Karst, in fact.

110310208.text: Is that... It is! It's Lady Ganyu!

110310209.text: Hahaha... I wouldn't have thought I'd meet you here. You were always so terribly busy.

110310210.text: "Lady Ganyu"? Why are you calling her that?

110310214.text: Ahem... Allow me to introduce Uncle Tian, he is...

110310215.text: That's alright, just tell them the truth. They have done so much for Liyue, after all, and I am the one who has yet to introduce myself.

110310216.text: ...Uncle Tian is a member of the Liyue Qixing, the "Tianshu."

110310217.text: What! This grandpa is a member of the Qixing?

110310219.text: Hush, now... I must ask for your discretion concerning my identity.

110310220.text: Fishing in the port and strolling about are the greatest pleasures of my life. I have no wish to be followed around by those armed guards.

110310221.text: In most people's eyes, I'm just a forgetful and wordy old man.

110310222.text: Uncle Tian is too modest. He's been around for a long time. There's no one who can replace a person of such noble character.

110310213.text: Ah... Please don't also start calling me that...

subQuests.subQuestName: Head to Yuehai Pavilion and speak to Huixin
Go to the Wanyou Boutique and talk to Bolai

110310401.text: Aha, we meet again, Traveler. And you must be... from the Yuehai Pavilion?

110310402.text: Hehe, I suppose you're about to place a big order. I'd be honored to offer you my wares.

110310403.text: That won't be necessary, Mr. Bolai. Wanyou Boutique's credit is not sufficient to accept orders directly from Yuehai Pavilion.

110310404.text: Should we need to place such an order, we would certainly go to Second Life instead.

110310406.text: Ugh... That rascal Dongsheng, he's stealing all of my customers.

110310407.text: Well, Second Life's credit has always been excellent, and based on their tax records, their business is thriving...

110310409.text: Huh? Is there anything you'd like to share with us, Mr. Bolai?

110310410.text: Don't let that rascal fool you. I know his dirty tricks best.

110310411.text: If you don't believe me, show me his tax records. I'm sure I'll find something fishy in there.

110310412.text: You know Second Life's business so well?

110310413.text: Of course! Their every transaction makes my blood boil!

110310414.text: I'd rather lose money myself than see that rascal make some!

110310417.text: Well then, please look over this tax record. We'll review Second Life's credit based on your observations.

110310418.text: Oh, of course. I'll read very, very carefully...

110310419.text: Line by line and word by word...

110310421.text: That exquisite, wooden furniture set he bought from Fanmu Carpenter's at the beginning of the year? He even flaunted it in front of me!

110310422.text: Look at the tax record, not a word about that furniture. And he kept all the profit for himself!

110310423.text: I see. He must've gotten rid of all the documents related to this transaction. No wonder there was no trace of it.

110310424.text: Hmph, I told you so. Just as I expected. I can't wait to watch him squirm.

110310425.text: But Ms. Ganyu... Despite all this, can't he just flat out deny ever making this transaction?

110310426.text: He might have destroyed all the evidence, but I believe the supplier, Fanmu Carpenter's, might still have some proof of it.

110310427.text: Aha, you're right! Master Lu from Fanmu Carpenter's must still have the invoice. He wouldn't be swayed by the likes of Dongsheng.

110310428.text: I hope so. Let's go to Fanmu Carpenter's. It should be near Qingce Village.

110310429.text: Thank you for shining a light on this case, Mr. Bolai.

110310430.text: Oh, please, please, that's nothing. I just hope you won't be lenient with him once you find the evidence. That's the best way to show your gratitude.

110310431.text: *sigh* I'm afraid I can't go to Qingce Village...

110310432.text: It's alright, Huixin. You can stay in Liyue Harbor and finish your work. Leave the rest to us.

110310433.text: Ah, that's so considerate of you. Still, I'm sorry to trouble you like that.

subQuests.subQuestName: Go to Fanmu Carpenter's and speak with Master Lu

110310501.text: Ah, welcome, welcome. How can an old carpenter like me help you?

110310502.text: I'm usually happy to take new apprentices, but I'm afraid I can't take too many at once. But I'm always around if you're keen for a chat...

110310503.text: Qingce really is full of lonely old people.

110310504.text: Hey, I heard that, flying one!

110310506.text: Master Lu, we've just come to see you and ask you some questions.

110310507.text: Hahaha... Ah, don't worry, I know — you're from the Yuehai Pavilion, right?

110310508.text: Why would the Qixing care about an old man like me? Well, whatever. You said that you want to ask me something — ask away, then.

110310509.text: Hehehe, you're very direct, Master Lu. I will be plain — we're looking for proof that Dongsheng from Second Life has been evading taxation.

110310510.text: Dongsheng bought some furniture from you at the beginning of the year. Do you still have the invoice or any other record of that transaction?

110310511.text: Oh, it's about Second Life. It was a big order, how could I forget?

110310512.text: Sure enough, Mr. Bolai was right.

110310513.text: Could we perhaps borrow that invoice? We won't have any evidence to bring against Dongsheng otherwise.

110310515.text: But... I'm not so sprightly anymore.

110310516.text: Uh, what's that supposed to mean?

110310517.text: I only do my woodwork and display finished wares here at Fanmu Carpenter's.

110310518.text: As for old documents and such, I keep them all in a warehouse, west of here.

110310519.text: But some troublemakers have recently moved there, invading my warehouse. I tried to drive them away, but they just wouldn't leave...

110310520.text: Since you need that invoice anyway... it may best to get it from the warehouse yourself. And while you're at it, you can teach those louts a lesson.

110310521.text: So that's what happened. I see.

110310522.text: I'll leave you to it then. I need to get back to work.

110310523.text: Take back the warehouse, find the invoice... Time for us to show our stuff in a fight!

110310524.text: Wait. I think I saw one of those troublemakers... Ah, over there!

110310525.text: Oh! Paimon sees them, too. It's one of the Fatui!

110310528.text: They must be plotting something against Liyue Harbor.

110310529.text: Maybe they're the scoundrels who invaded Master Lu's warehouse.

110310530.text: Shouldn't we observe him for a while first?

110310531.text: Ever since Osial attacked the harbor, the Fatui's reputation in Liyue has reached rock bottom.

110310532.text: We won't cause a serious diplomatic crisis by getting into some small scuffle with the Fatui within our borders. You need not worry.

110310533.text: Besides, I can already feel their malicious intentions. Consider it...

110310534.text: ...My intuition as the secretary of the Qixing.

110310535.text: Then what are we waiting for? Let's go teach him a lesson!

110310802.text: I hope it wasn't too much trouble rushing about like that...

110310803.text: I promised to help you and I'll keep my word. Nothing to worry about.

110310804.text: Look, it's the invoice for the transaction between Second Life and Fanmu Carpenter's. We've brought it back.

110310805.text: *sigh* Thank you so much! Now we can solve this problem.

110310806.text: Agreed. How about we go to Second Life and... have a nice chat with the owner?

subQuests.subQuestName: Talk to the suspicious Fatui underling

110310702.text: I think you've had enough. About time you tell us your plan, no?

110310704.text: We just taught you a lesson, but clearly, you weren't paying attention.

110310705.text: If you don't spill whatever you're scheming against Liyue...

110310706.text: We'll be forced to use harsher methods.

110310709.text: I'm telling the truth. There's no scheme.

110310710.text: If you're telling the truth, then why would you, a member of the Fatui, suddenly appear on the outskirts of Qingce Village?

110310711.text: Fine. If you really want to know, then, well... I was about to...

110310715.text: I must admit, I didn't expect you to come up with such a silly excuse.

110310716.text: It's not an excuse! I rarely have a free morning, and I heard that there were fresh Berries in this area...

110310717.text: Think about it. I'm here alone and Qingce Village is nothing more than a retirement spot for old people. What could I be scheming, anyway?

110310718.text: Judging by how he's looking at us, it does seem like he feels like he's the victim here.

110310719.text: So you have nothing to do with the occupation of Fanmu Carpenter's warehouse?

110310720.text: Fanmu Carpenter's warehouse? Where is that?

110310721.text: I swear, I only came here to pick Berries, that's all.

110310722.text: So it wasn't the Fatui who took over Master Lu's warehouse, after all...

subQuests.subQuestName: Clear the warehouse of its occupants

110311001.text: Eh, don't think too much about it. My daughter really needs Ganyu's help, and there's nothing more to it, hehe...

subQuests.subQuestName: Look for the invoice from Second Life

110311101.text: Don't forget to drive those hooligans away. It'll save me the trouble of asking for the Millelith's help, too...

subQuests.subQuestName: Return to Yuehai Pavilion and speak to Huixin
Talk to Dongsheng at Second Life

110310902.text: Isn't it... Huixin from the Yuehai Pavilion? I remember you.

110310903.text: I told you that all of my transactions are included in the records. My tax declarations are scrupulous, as well.

110310904.text: I do hope that my business won't be affected by any groundless accusations.

110310905.text: Groundless accusations? Mr. Dongsheng, you seem very sure of yourself.

110310906.text: But I sincerely advise that you cease this behavior immediately. It is liable to affect the fine you'll need to pay in the end.

110310907.text: Ah... No, no, I'm an honest merchant. I would never get involved with any fraudulent sources of profit.

110310910.text: Haven't I made myself clear? Mr. Dongsheng, you've already been proven guilty of tax evasion. I just came here to see if you'd confess.

110310911.text: What? P—Proven guilty? H—How come? That's impossible. Absolutely absurd!

110310912.text: He's talking without rhyme or reason. Must be crumbling under Ganyu's pressure.

110310914.text: Mr. Dongsheng, can you tell me what this is?

110310915.text: I... It... It's an invoice from Fanmu Carpenter's!

110310916.text: I... I'm... Master Lu, he... I didn't...

110310917.text: Do you admit to tax evasion? This transaction was absent from the tax record.

110310918.text: *sigh* I didn't think you'd find out. I didn't leave a single trace.

110310919.text: Indeed, we wouldn't have found out if it weren't for Mr. Bolai's aid.

110310920.text: Bolai? That imp from Wanyou Boutique... So he told on me behind my back!

110310921.text: Hmph, he's got his own share of dirty laundry...

110310922.text: Oh? Mr. Dongsheng, I'd like to hear a little more about this "dirty laundry." Would you care to elaborate?

110310923.text: I don't think you'll need my guidance for what comes next.

110310924.text: Yes, thank you, Ms. Ganyu! I can take it from here.

110310926.text: *sigh* I must say, you're truly impressive, Ms. Ganyu.

110310928.text: To think — you came up with this plan and executed it so masterfully.

110310929.text: Hehe. It's actually one of your father's — the Tianshu's — old tricks. I just took some inspiration from it.

110310931.text: Pitting your opponent against their enemies and watching them drag each other down from an advantageous position.

110310932.text: That's how Uncle Tian managed to keep his position in the Qixing secure for so many years.

110310933.text: I figured that as Uncle Tian's daughter, you'd naturally grasp your father's strategies.

110310934.text: So I decided to use one of your father's tricks and play it out for you to see.

110310935.text: *sigh* I can see it now... Clearly, I still have a lot to learn about my father.

110310936.text: I'm really grateful, Ms. Ganyu! Heh, you're the kindest mentor I've ever had! Thank you!

110310937.text: Ganyu's solved both Huixin's work and family problems. Two birds with one stone!

110310938.text: Oh, you've helped me so much. You must... You must allow me to repay your kindness...

110310939.text: Ah, that's not necessary. No need to be so serious. It was nothing, really.

110310940.text: Then... let me treat you to a meal, hmm? The Traveler and Paimon are invited as well. I appreciate your help!

110310941.text: Alright! Come on, Ganyu, just say yes! Let's eat!
